WHITE = scene["baskets"]["white basket"]
wx, wy = WHITE["center"][0], WHITE["center"][1]
w_floor = WHITE["lower"][2]

def go(arm, jaw, tilt, jl, interaction, speed=None, slow=False, tag=""):

        r = move_jaw(arm, jaw, tilt, jl, interaction=interaction, speed=speed, slow=slow, tag=tag)
    except ToolRefused as e:
        handoff(f"move refused: {tag}", code=e.code, answer=str(e.answer)[:900])
    if not r.ok:
        handoff(f"move failed: {tag}", status=r.status, code=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
    return r

def pepper_near(p, cam="head"):
    r = tools.vision_ground(camera=cam, text="pepper", max_candidates=3)
    out = []
    for c in r["result"]["candidates"]:
        og = object_geometry(c)
        out.append((float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(og.center_xyz_m) - np.asarray(p))), np.asarray(og.center_xyz_m), og))
    out.sort(key=lambda t: t[0])
    return out

# ---- measure the yellow pepper fresh
cands = pepper_near([0.1541, -0.1415, 0.8134])
print("peppers:", [(round(d,3), np.round(c,4).tolist()) for d, c, _ in cands])
if cands[0][0] > 0.04:
    handoff("yellow pepper not found", best=cands[0][1].tolist())
_, pc, og = cands[0]
support = float(og.support_z_m); top = float(og.aabb_max_xyz_m[2])
mid_z = 0.5 * (support + top)
jaw_grasp = np.array([pc[0], pc[1], mid_z])
print("pepper top", round(top,4), "support", round(support,4), "mid", round(mid_z,4))

TILT_G = 20
jaw_pre = jaw_grasp + np.array([0, 0, 0.08])
print("grasp jaw", np.round(jaw_grasp,4), "pre", np.round(jaw_pre,4))

# ---- probe the first moves from the current state
probe_poses = []
for j in (jaw_pre, jaw_grasp):
    f = jaw_flange(j, TILT_G); q = jaw_quat(TILT_G, (1,0,0))
    probe_poses.append([float(v) for v in f] + [float(v) for v in q])
pr = robot.query("probe_motion", arm="left", poses=probe_poses)
print("probe pre/grasp:", [rr.get("reachable") for rr in pr.get("results", [])])

# ---- pick
if pr["results"][0].get("reachable"):
    go("left", jaw_pre, TILT_G, (1,0,0), "free_space", tag="pregrasp")
go("left", jaw_grasp, TILT_G, (1,0,0), "precision", speed="careful", tag="grasp descend")
g = tools.set_gripper(targets={"left": "close"})
print("close:", g.status, g.failure_code)
go("left", jaw_pre, TILT_G, (1,0,0), "free_space", speed="normal", tag="lift")

# ---- verify the pepper rose with the gripper
after = pepper_near(jaw_grasp)
print("peppers after lift:", [(round(d,3), np.round(c,4).tolist()) for d, c, _ in after])
held = after[0][0] < 0.05 and after[0][1][2] > mid_z + 0.03
print("held:", held, "dist", round(after[0][0],4), "z", round(after[0][1][2],4))
if not held:
    handoff("pepper did not rise with the gripper", measured=after[0][1].tolist(), grasp_jaw=jaw_grasp.tolist())

# ---- carry to the white basket and release
jaw_transit = np.array([wx, wy - 0.045, 0.93])
jaw_release = np.array([wx, wy - 0.045, 0.82])
jaw_up      = np.array([wx, wy - 0.045, 0.95])
go("left", jaw_transit, 30, (1,0,0), "free_space", speed="normal", tag="transit white")
go("left", jaw_release, 30, (1,0,0), "precision", speed="normal", slow=True, tag="release descend")
g = tools.set_gripper(targets={"left": "open"})
print("open:", g.status, g.failure_code)
go("left", jaw_up, 30, (1,0,0), "free_space", speed="normal", tag="retreat")

# ---- verify inside the white basket
post = pepper_near(jaw_release)
print("peppers after place:", [(round(d,3), np.round(c,4).tolist()) for d, c, _ in post])
inside = [c for d, c, _ in post
          if abs(c[0]-wx) < 0.12 and abs(c[1]-wy) < 0.10 and c[2] > w_floor + 0.003 and c[2] < WHITE["upper"][2]]
print("inside white:", [np.round(c,4).tolist() for c in inside])
if not inside:
    handoff("pepper not measured inside the white basket", after=[np.round(c,4).tolist() for _,c,_ in post])
print("DONE step4")

"""Full-table inventory from the head camera's depth, plus cluster geometry."""
import numpy as np
from ora_lib import current
from skimage import measure

TABLE_Z = 0.7655
def scan(obs=None, cam_name="head", zmin=0.777, zmax=1.05, min_px=60, cam=None):
    obs = obs or current()
    cam = obs.camera(cam_name)
    depth = np.asarray(cam.depth_m, float)
    K = np.asarray(cam.K, float)
    T = np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world, float)   # camera -> world
    h, w = depth.shape
    u, v = np.meshgrid(np.arange(w), np.arange(h))
    valid = np.isfinite(depth) & (depth > 0.05) & (depth < 3.0)
    zc = depth[valid]
    uc, vc = u[valid], v[valid]
    xc = (uc - K[0,2]) * zc / K[0,0]
    yc = (vc - K[1,2]) * zc / K[1,1]
    pts_c = np.stack([xc, yc, zc], axis=1)
    pts_w = pts_c @ T[:3,:3].T + T[:3,3]
    mask = np.zeros((h,w), bool)
    keep = (pts_w[:,2] > zmin) & (pts_w[:,2] < zmax)
    idx = np.flatnonzero(keep)
    m2 = np.zeros((h,w), bool)
    m2[vc[idx], uc[idx]] = True
    lab = measure.label(m2, connectivity=2)
    out = []
    for region in measure.regionprops(lab):
        if region.area < min_px:
            continue
        sel = lab == region.label
        # world points of this label
        ptsel = np.zeros(len(pts_w), bool)
        ptsel[idx] = sel[vc[idx], uc[idx]]
        P = pts_w[ptsel]
        c = P.mean(axis=0)
        mn, mx = P.min(axis=0), P.max(axis=0)
        out.append(dict(n=int(region.area), center=[round(float(x),4) for x in c],
                        lo=[round(float(x),4) for x in mn], hi=[round(float(x),4) for x in mx],
                        bbox=[int(x) for x in region.bbox]))
    out.sort(key=lambda d: -d["n"])
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    obs = current()
    for cam_name in ("head",):
        print("==", cam_name)
        for o in scan(obs, cam_name):
